record.oneLiner: A horned ceratopsian with a spectacular spiked frill.
record.description: Styracosaurus was a large horned dinosaur of Late Cretaceous North America, bearing four to six long spikes on its neck frill and a single long nose horn. A bulky quadrupedal herbivore, it sliced plants with shearing cheek-teeth and may have lived in herds.

notableFacts.text: Bore four to six long spikes on its neck frill plus a long nose horn.
Its nose horn may have reached 60 cm long.
